en: Improved the "Connection dropped" API error: it now says where to look first (the proxy or gateway in use, else VPN or firewall; Anthropic API only, Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
zh: 改进“Connection dropped”API 错误：现在会说明应首先排查的位置（所用代理或网关，否则 VPN 或防火墙；仅适用于 Anthropic API，Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry 不变）
